title: Among users who have only one type of post history activity, find the displ
question: Among users who have only one type of post history activity, find the display name of the one who owns the most valuable post (i.e., highest FavoriteCount). If there is a tie, prefer the user with the most recently created account.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE T1."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_017"
    FROM postHistory
    GROUP BY "XCL_017"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "XCL_013") = 1
)
ORDER BY T2."XCL_039" DESC, T1."XCL_054" DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH UserPostTypes AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.XCL_017 AS UserId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ph.XCL_015) AS DistinctPostTypes
    FROM postHistory ph
    GROUP BY ph.XCL_017
),
UsersWithOneType AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM UserPostTypes
    WHERE DistinctPostTypes = 1
),
UserMaxFavorite AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_033 AS UserId,
        MAX(p.XCL_037) AS MaxFavoriteCount
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN UsersWithOneType uwt ON p.XCL_033 = uwt.UserId
    GROUP BY p.XCL_033
),
RankedUsers AS (
    SELECT 
        u.XCL_052 AS UserId,
        u.XCL_057 AS DisplayName,
        umf.MaxFavoriteCount,
        u.XCL_054 AS CreationDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY umf.MaxFavoriteCount DESC, u.XCL_054 DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM UserMaxFavorite umf
    INNER JOIN users u ON umf.UserId = u.XCL_052
)
SELECT DisplayName
FROM RankedUsers
WHERE rn = 1
